text_block_list.text: I've come to a shrine with Кинг Хало.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh. I haven't been feeling myself lately...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should say a little prayer—just
enough
for some peace of mind.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: We've come all the way here, after all.

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I believe I shall give the gods the

opportunity to make my wishes come
true!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Why don't you say a prayer too? Just
waiting
around would be a waste of time.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: And so, I pray with Кинг Хало.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Grant me a tremendous victory in the
next race...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And may my road to glory continue to
shine with
dazzling light!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh, and also, I want good health, no
traffic
accidents, and lots of joy for the
younger
students!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Standing beside her, I can hear King
Hero voicing
her prayers with unusual
seriousness.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I think that's everything. May all
my
wishes be granted!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a gentle breeze caresses my
cheek.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, what a pleasant breeze. Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I feel a little better somehow. This god is
a good
listener!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Whew... To have even the gods on my
side feels
like my charm has bewitched
the heavens.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's a first-rate Umamusume for
you! ♪
Ohohoho! Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a strong gust of wind blows
through,
rustling the surrounding trees.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Caw! Caw!
text_block_list.name: Crow

text_block_list.text: Gyaaah!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Wh-wh-what was that?! I felt an ominous

presence!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Wh-what could have drawn these
ill-fated omens
to me?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh wait, I get it... You're trying to get
me to buy
a lucky charm, aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
What greedy little gods you are... Fine,
I'll play
along just this once.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I should buy one soon before they sell
out!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
After that, Кинг Хало clutches her new
charm with
a worried expression on her
face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Following that, Кинг Хало's performance
in
training improves.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
